control.$description: Dark: Primary buttons only: a slight lift so the main action feels pressable. Same layers at higher opacity (specimen tool), since shadows barely show on dark surfaces; raised and floating surfaces also step lighter (color.dark.surface-steps).

raised.$description: Dark: Panels and tables on the page: the direction separates panels by shadow. Soft, two layers. Same layers at higher opacity (specimen tool), since shadows barely show on dark surfaces; raised and floating surfaces also step lighter (color.dark.surface-steps).

featured.$description: Dark: The featured surface (the job that needs action): lifts much further than a panel. Same layers at higher opacity (specimen tool), since shadows barely show on dark surfaces; raised and floating surfaces also step lighter (color.dark.surface-steps).

overlay.$description: Dark: Floating layers: menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs (dialogs add the scrim). The 1px layer gives the edge on white without a border. Same layers at higher opacity (specimen tool), since shadows barely show on dark surfaces; raised and floating surfaces also step lighter (color.dark.surface-steps).

scrim.$description: Dark: neutral 950 at 65%, so dialogs stand out from an already dark page.
